t: This is the Church of St Barnabas in Shacklewell, in the London Borough of Hackney. It was designed by Charles Herbert Reilly, an English architect who trained in two London practices. He went on to become a teacher, and from 1904 to 1933 he headed the University of Liverpool School of Architecture, which became world-famous under his leadership. He was largely responsible for establishing university training of architects as an alternative to apprenticeship.
